'''Pychor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who as [[Captain/Legends|captain]] aboard the [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Pychor was a member of the crew of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ''Devastator''. He approached [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] as the former was locked in a fit of pique, and reacted somewhat nervously.
